verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, official JavaScript and Python client libraries, an OpenAPI spec, and an official MCP server, but nothing mentions an official Asana command-line tool. SDKs and the MCP server are developer building blocks or a different capability, so they earn no credit for this story. A SaaS work-management platform could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
